Behavior.PumpCreatureRecipe_8715_activat.reason: Unyaro Bees raises a native x86 access violation during EVENT_ACTIVATE. Its DIALOG call omits the comma after DLG_AUTOCHOOSE_IF_1: adjacent literals merge the first option label into a flag, leaving the following integer legality argument to be read as a pointer. The same scenarios pass under Wasm. This native-only expectation requires the exact SEH code, case identity, and activation step; correct Oracle payment, stack, +1/+1, cleanup, and zone assertions remain beyond the exception. Production fix deferred.
